quote: indicated for the treatment of serious gynecological infections including endometritis, nongonococcal tubo-ovarian abscess, pelvic cellulitis
note: Endometritis is a named item in the list of indicated gynecological infections.

quote: indicated for the relief of the nasal and non-nasal symptoms of seasonal allergic rhinitis, including nasal congestion
note: Symptomatic management of seasonal allergic rhinitis is named, with the decongestant role attributed to pseudoephedrine, and single-ingredient labels relieve nasal congestion due to hay fever (seasonal allergic rhinitis).

quote: IMBRUVICA is indicated for the treatment of adult and pediatric patients age 1 year and older with chronic graft-versus-host disease (cGVHD)
note: Chronic GVHD is named directly as a treatment indication.

quote: Gastrointestinal absorption is impaired by obstruction, inflammatory disease or its complications
note: Inflammatory bowel disease appears only as the underlying condition making parenteral nutrition necessary; the amino acid product treats nutritional deficit, not the bowel disease.

quote: Tinidazole is indicated for the treatment of bacterial vaginosis (formerly referred to as Haemophilus vaginitis, Gardnerella vaginitis, nonspecific vaginitis, or anaerobic vaginosis) in adult women
note: Bacterial vaginosis is named directly as a treatment indication.

quote: It is indicated for depression accompanied by anxiety or agitation.
note: The thing treated is depression; anxiety only qualifies the depressive population and is not itself the indicated condition.

quote: Treatment of major depressive episodes in adults.
note: Major depressive episodes are the defining feature of major depressive disorder, an exact clinical synonym.

quote: Ivabradine is indicated in chronic heart failure NYHA II to IV class with systolic dysfunction
note: Chronic heart failure with systolic dysfunction is congestive heart failure by standard synonymy.

quote: Anastrozole is indicated for the treatment of advanced breast cancer in postmenopausal women with disease progression following tamoxifen therapy.
note: Advanced breast cancer is named verbatim as a treatment indication.

quote: Formulated for symptoms associated with performance anxiety such as apprehension, nausea, restlessness, trembling and over-sensitivity.
note: The texts offer relief of anxiety as a symptom or feeling (performance anxiety symptoms, general anxiety), not treatment of a diagnosed anxiety disorder.

quote: QULIPTA is indicated for the preventive treatment of migraine in adults.
note: Migraine prevention (FDA) and acute treatment/prophylaxis of migraine (EMA) are named directly.

quote: 1.1 Maintenance Treatment of COPD Arformoterol tartrate inhalation solution is indicated for the long-term, twice daily (morning and evening) maintenance treatment of bronchoconstriction
note: The label itself heads this as maintenance treatment of COPD; treating the bronchoconstriction of COPD is management of the disease.

quote: ankylosing spondylitis; acute and subacute bursitis; acute nonspecific tenosynovitis
note: Acute and subacute bursitis are named in the rheumatic disorders list as adjunctive therapy indications, a subtype of bursitis.

quote: As adjunctive therapy for short-term administration (to tide the patient over an acute episode or exacerbation) in acute gouty arthritis; acute rheumatic carditis; ankylosing spondylitis
note: Ankylosing spondylitis is a named item in the rheumatic disorders indication list; adjunctive therapy still counts.

quote: Captopril decreases the rate of progression of renal insufficiency and development of serious adverse clinical outcomes (death or need for renal transplantation or dialysis).
note: Within the diabetic nephropathy indication the label states captopril slows progression of renal insufficiency and prevents the need for dialysis or transplantation, i.e. manages and prevents kidney failure.

quote: Esmolol hydrochloride in sodium chloride injection is also indicated in non-compensatory sinus tachycardia where, in the physician’s judgment, the rapid heart rate requires specific intervention.
note: Non-compensatory sinus tachycardia is a named indication, a subtype of sinus tachycardia.

quote: LITFULO is a kinase inhibitor indicated for the treatment of severe alopecia areata in adults and adolescents 12 years and older.
note: Severe alopecia areata is a more specific form of alopecia areata named as the treatment target.

quote: First aid to help protect against infection in minor cuts, scrapes, and burns.
note: The supplied text covers only topical first-aid antisepsis of minor skin wounds; HIV is not mentioned anywhere.

quote: KESIMPTA is indicated for the treatment of relapsing forms of multiple sclerosis (MS), to include clinically isolated syndrome, relapsing-remitting disease, and active secondary progressive disease
note: Relapsing forms of multiple sclerosis are a subtype of multiple sclerosis named as the treatment target.

quote: Gliolan is indicated in adult patients for visualisation of malignant tissue during surgery for malignant glioma (World Health Organization grade III and IV).
note: The agent is a diagnostic/intraoperative visualisation aid; glioblastoma (grade IV glioma) is the surgical setting, not something the drug treats.

quote: TEPMETKO is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with metastatic non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) harboring mesenchymal-epithelial transition ( MET ) exon 14 skipping alterations.
note: Metastatic MET exon 14 NSCLC is a more specific form of non-small cell lung carcinoma named as the treatment target.

quote: Amversio is indicated as adjunctive treatment of homocystinuria, involving deficiencies or defects in: cystathionine beta-synthase (CBS)
note: Homocystinuria is named directly as the (adjunctive) treatment indication.

quote: temporarily relieves minor aches and pains due to: headache muscle pain toothache menstrual pain colds minor pain of arthritis
note: Toothache is itself a pain condition and is a named item in the list of pains relieved.

quote: adjunctive treatment of adult patients with severe active anti-neutrophil cytoplasmic autoantibody (ANCA)-associated vasculitis (granulomatosis with polyangiitis [GPA]
note: Granulomatosis with polyangiitis is explicitly named as one of the ANCA-associated vasculitides treated; adjunctive therapy counts.

quote: Ninlaro in combination with lenalidomide and dexamethasone is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with multiple myeloma who have received at least one prior therapy.
note: Multiple myeloma is an exact synonym of plasma cell myeloma; combination therapy counts.

quote: indicated to improve survival of stable adult patients with symptomatic heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (≤40%) (HFrEF) after an acute myocardial infarction (MI)
note: Acute MI is the background event defining the population; the condition treated is post-MI heart failure, and the other MI mentions are generic antihypertensive class statements.

quote: COPIKTRA is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with relapsed or refractory chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL) or small lymphocytic lymphoma (SLL)
note: The supplied text names only CLL/SLL; follicular lymphoma is not mentioned anywhere in indications, limitations, contraindications or warnings.

quote: the absolute benefit is greater in patients who are at higher risk independent of their hypertension (for example, patients with diabetes or hyperlipidemia)
note: Hyperlipidemia appears only as a comorbid risk-factor population in the generic hypertension rationale; the indication is hypertension.

quote: indicated for the prophylaxis of acute organ rejection in patients receiving renal transplantation
note: What is prevented is acute organ rejection; renal transplantation is the population/setting rather than the thing treated.

quote: Leflunomide is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with: active rheumatoid arthritis as a 'disease-modifying antirheumatic drug' (DMARD); active psoriatic arthritis.
note: Active psoriatic arthritis is named directly in the EMA indication.

quote: Control of severe or incapacitating allergic conditions intractable to adequate trials of conventional treatment in adult and pediatric populations with: seasonal or perennial allergic rhinitis;
note: Contact dermatitis is a named item in the allergic states indication list.

quote: Myocardial Infarction Propranolol hydrochloride tablets, USP are indicated to reduce cardiovascular mortality in patients who have survived the acute phase of myocardial infarction
note: The label lists Myocardial Infarction as its own indication heading, with propranolol used for post-infarction management to reduce cardiovascular mortality.

quote: indicated in combination with other antiretroviral medicinal products for the treatment of human immunodeficiency virus (HIV 1) infection in adult and paediatric patients
note: HIV-1 infection is named directly as the treatment indication; combination antiretroviral therapy counts.

quote: temporarily relieves these symptoms due to hay fever or other upper respiratory allergies: runny nose itchy, watery eyes sneezing itching of the nose or throat
note: Hay fever is allergic rhinitis, and relieving its defining nasal and ocular symptoms is symptomatic management of the disease itself.

quote: indicated for the prevention of atherothrombotic events in adult patients after an acute coronary syndrome (ACS) with elevated cardiac biomarkers
note: The target is prevention of atherothrombotic events; acute coronary syndrome is the prior event defining the population.

quote: Ammonia N-13 Injection, USP is indicated for diagnostic Positron Emission Tomography (PET) imaging of the myocardium
note: The supplied texts cover PET myocardial imaging, muscle aches and fainting/alertness; pruritus or itching is not mentioned anywhere.

quote: Inductos is indicated for the treatment of acute tibia fractures in adults, as an adjunct to standard care using open fracture reduction and intramedullary unreamed nail fixation.
note: Acute tibia fractures are named directly as the (adjunctive) treatment indication.

quote: Acute painful shoulder (Acute subacromial bursitis/supraspinatus tendinitis)
note: Supraspinatus tendinitis is explicitly named within the acute painful shoulder indication for relief of signs and symptoms.
